sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2023
sources.text: The master confirmed some items from a container (ship properties and store) and one coil of mooring rope were stolen. There was no confrontation between the perpetrators with crew. All crew members were safe. The master reported the incident to local agent and Singapore upon arrival in Singapore on 17 Jun 23. Safety navigational broadcast was initiated.
